body: Nit, but in other tests we wrap this into a `createMockedSearchClient` function and instantiate a new client in each test. This would work the same, but the benefits are that you don't need to clear between tests, and you can keep the mock at the end of the file so it's not the first thing you see when reading the tests.
Could we test against an inline snapshot instead? It makes it easier to understand what the full output is.
